description: Expected activity of lifetime.json at its boundary times. Pure data, derived by hand from the rule below (D42.2, D42.4) and never generated from an implementation. `active` lists, in document order, the nodes whose own lifetime contains the time: exactly the nodes whose state must say `active: true`. `shown` lists the nodes whose element is not hidden, which also needs the group of a child to be active: exactly the elements without an effective `visibility: hidden`. `positionX` is the evaluated x of life-text, which shows that an inactive node is still evaluated and that its animation runs on composition time.
rule: A node is active at t exactly when t >= startUs and t - startUs < durationUs (D42.2).

life-background: [1 000 000, 9 000 000). life-group: [2 000 000, 5 000 000). life-child-always: [0, 10 000 000). life-child-late: [4 000 000, 6 000 000). life-text: [8 000 000, 13 000 000), cut by the end of the composition. life-never: starts at the end, never active. life-html: [0, 1), the time 0 only.
active is local: a child's lifetime does not depend on its group's (D42.3).
A node is shown exactly when it is active and, for a child, its group is active too (D42.4).
life-text has base x 20 and a position animation from offset 0 at time 0 to offset 100 at time 10 000 000, so its x at t is 20 + (100 * t) / 10 000 000 (D18.3, D18.4), whether or not it is active.
